**Finding: Compliant (no redline).**

Section 22 is the sole audit right binding us, and it lands at the playbook's preferred position on every material term:

- **Frequency** — no more than once in any twelve-month period (22.1)
- **Notice** — at least thirty days' prior written notice (22.1)
- **Conduct** — normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality (22.1)
- **Cost** — Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2)
- **System access** — express bar on direct access to our systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information (22.2)

Section 22.3 adds further customer-favourable terms (findings are our Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, copy of the final report, finality on payment). Section 23 holds only a heading, but reciprocal customer assurance rights fall outside this rule.
